parameters.content:
## 1 · Receive & validate
Token auth and file type check. The OCR service also verifies the real file signature,
size (10 MB) and page limits. Exact duplicates (same file hash) are answered
without re-processing.

## 2 · Read & extract
Digital PDFs use the text layer; scans and photos go through Tesseract OCR.
OpenAI transcribes fields into a strict JSON schema — it is told never to fix numbers.
Unreadable documents and AI outages go to manual review instead of failing.

## 3 · Validate
Required fields, dates, line math (qty × price),
sum of lines = subtotal, subtotal + tax = total,
and duplicate invoice number per vendor.

## 4 · Store, respond & notify
Invoice + line items saved in one transaction.
The caller gets the extracted data and any issues;
finance is notified in #invoices.

INSERT INTO execution_log (request_id, project, workflow, idempotency_key, status, detail, latency_ms)
VALUES ($1::uuid, '02-document-extraction', 'invoice-intake', $2, 'duplicate', 'Existing invoice id ' || $3, $4);

WITH inv AS (
  INSERT INTO invoices (request_id, file_name, file_sha256, extraction_method, is_invoice, vendor_name, vendor_tax_id,
                        invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, currency, subtotal, tax, total, status, issues, raw_text, llm_model)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, NULLIF($5::text, '')::boolean, NULLIF($6::text, ''), NULLIF($7::text, ''),
          NULLIF($8::text, ''), NULLIF($9::text, '')::date, NULLIF($10::text, '')::date, NULLIF($11::text, ''),
          NULLIF($12::text, '')::numeric, NULLIF($13::text, '')::numeric, NULLIF($14::text, '')::numeric,
          $15, $16::jsonb, $17, NULLIF($18::text, ''))
  RETURNING *
), items AS (
  INSERT INTO invoice_items (invoice_id, line_no, description, quantity, unit_price, amount)
  SELECT inv.id, x.line_no, x.description, x.quantity, x.unit_price, x.amount
  FROM inv, jsonb_to_recordset($19::jsonb) AS x(line_no int, description text, quantity numeric, unit_price numeric, amount numeric)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT inv.id, inv.status, (SELECT count(*) FROM items) AS item_count FROM inv;
